title: Vision Response to Dopamine Replacement
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate and document physiologic and functional changes in visual performance and retinal function of patients diagnosed with albinism (a dopamine deficiency state) following a trial of oral Levodopa/carbidopa treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* clinical diagnosis of oculocutaneous albinism
* age over 3 and weight over 25 lbs.

Exclusion Criteria:

* ocular only albinism
* ocular pathology other than albinism
* neurologic disease, history of myocardial infarction, history of clinical depression, pregnancy
